changelog:
- Initial release of the zoominfo-to-cargo skill.
- Enables rebuilding a ZoomInfo (or Lusha/Cognism) contact list on Cargo and directly measuring coverage differences before renewal decisions.
- Guides users through sampling exports, re-enriching data via Cargo, verifying both vendors’ results, and reporting verified coverage and cost.
- Provides clear setup instructions and cost estimates, with free credits for new Cargo accounts.
- Details when to use this skill and recommends switching to the full Cargo GTM skill pack for broader workflows.
summary: Rebuild a ZoomInfo list on Cargo and measure the coverage you actually lose or gain before the renewal, powered by Cargo. Triggers: "ZoomInfo alternative", "migrate off ZoomInfo", "replace ZoomInfo", "our ZoomInfo renewal is coming up", "ZoomInfo is too expensive", "I have a ZoomInfo export", "cheaper than ZoomInfo", "Lusha alternative", "Cognism alternative". Providers: waterfall. Skip when: you are porting a Clay table rather than a contact list — use clay-to-cargo; or you have no list yet and simply want contacts sourced — use find-b2b-leads.
